en: <Color:255,200,200,255>But it's the slowly part I can't do. Bein' together with someone I like and talkin' alone with that person don't happen too often.
<Color:255,200,200,255>So I figure I have to say somethin' at those moments, and wind up sayin' too much.
At least you've found the issue. The next time you have an opportunity come along, you can make your move slowly, without being flustered.
<Color:255,200,200,255>I know that in my head, but when the time comes, it all goes out the window and I can't say what I wanna say.<Color:Default>
Why not try sending a letter then? Then you can write while you're feeling more calm and won't mess up what you're trying to say.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Good idea! Can't get girlier than love letters. And if I mess up, I can rewrite it as many times as I need. That's perfect for me!<Color:Default>
Hey, best of luck.
So, how about now?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Right now I'm fine. Why do ya ask?<Color:Default>
No real reason.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Oh! Akiyama-san, you're wonderin' if I might like you, aren't ya?<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>Sorry, but when it's me and you, I just feel super relaxed!<Color:Default>
Why not practice? Pretend I'm a guy that you're into and see how you do.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Yer kinda puttin' me on the spot, though...<Color:Default>
Come on, let's do this. Ready, and... go!
<Color:255,200,200,255>Pfft! Oh, yer face! One look at yer face right now and I can't even help but laugh!<Color:Default>
That's... an odd reaction.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Akiyama-san, I bet ya've got a good eye for the ladies. You strike me as a guy who only dates women of a real high caliber.<Color:Default>
Maybe. I definitely couldn't date just anyone. If I'm going to date a person, I suppose I need to consider their merits first.
And not just women, either. You stand a lot to gain by being with people you respect in one way or another. Those are the kind of people I choose.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Wow, ya've really thought this through, haven't ya? So, do I have any merits?<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>Oh yeah? Like what?<Color:Default>
You're cute, considerate, and fun to talk to. Plus, I have a great time drinking with you.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Well yeah, of course. Showin' my customers a good time is my job!<Color:Default>
But a lot of girls can't pull it off like you. All successful hostesses have a special something. I don't ask for girls I don't find interesting.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Aww, you're makin' me blush, layin' all those compliments on me!<Color:Default>
Hmm... It's not like we're dating or anything right now, so I haven't thought about it much.
<Color:255,200,200,255>So does that mean ya wouldn't wanna date me?<Color:Default>
I mean, aren't the primary benefits of a cabaret club that you can enjoy drinks with a girl, for a limited time, and without any strings attached?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Well, yeah, but... Aww, that don't sound right.<Color:Default>
I'm not as discerning as you.
<Color:255,200,200,255>I'm not all that discernin'. As long as someone is interestin', then fine by me.<Color:Default>
Simple enough. What about other things, though? Like looks, or money?
<Color:255,200,200,255>I'm just talkin' about folks who've got a good head on their shoulders. So they pay attention to their looks and have a job already. They're proper adults.<Color:Default>
That's fair enough. Most unsophisticated people are pretty much hopeless and boring.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Right? So if I'm gonna date a guy, he's for sure gotta be interestin'!<Color:Default>
That's discerning. You can't expect a normal guy to entertain you like a professional comedian.
<Color:255,200,200,255>I know that. He doesn't hafta do comedy skits or nothin'. He just needs to have a generous spirit that tries to entertain others.<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>Like, hosts who have that ability are in demand, right? No matter how hot a guy is, he's no fun if he keeps his mouth shut.<Color:Default>
I see. That's one way to look at it.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Compatibility's a big thing for me. Like in stand-up comedy, you need a funny man and a straight man. Otherwise, it ain't gonna go well.<Color:Default>
Heh. Which one are you?
<Color:255,200,200,255>I'm the straight man. Which means I wanna pair up with a funny man.<Color:Default>
I'd say I'm a funny guy. At least, that's what people are always whispering behind my back, heh.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Pfft, no ya ain't! You're totally a straight man!<Color:Default>
Busted. You're really good at tripping people up. It almost feels a little unfair.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Comedy is a gift. It never works if ya ain't compatible with someone. You're suited to bein' a straight man, Akiyama-san.<Color:Default>
Well, that's too bad.
I mean it. Why don't you believe me?
<Color:255,200,200,255>It's 'cause ya always know what ya gotta say to get to the punch line. The funny man's the one that sets things up for the straight man.<Color:Default>
I guess you've got a point. I suppose I've been playing that role pretty often lately.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Yep. If you were the funny man, then ya'd bumble the conversation at already awkward points, to make it even more awkward than it was, ya know?<Color:Default>
I guess I wound up becoming a pretty boring guy without even realizing it. I should be careful.
Now make your joke! I totally gave you a setup!
<Color:255,200,200,255>Ya just said the whole thing! Yer totally a straight man, Akiyama-san.<Color:Default>
Agh! I totally got myself backwards there.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Ya've got a long way to go.<Color:Default>
I'm a straight man too. Does that make us incompatible?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Maybe...<Color:Default>
Maybe? What do you mean by that?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Well, since I like funny men, I've never dated someone who's a straight man.<Color:Default>
Want to give it a shot? Maybe things won't turn out so bad this time.
<Color:255,200,200,255>But we might never get to the punch line without a setup, and our conversations might never stop.<Color:Default>
Maybe we can make it a game, where the person who runs out of stuff to say first pays a penalty.
<Color:255,200,200,255>That sounds like it could be fun! I wonder how those conversations would go?<Color:Default>
You're the funny man. You don't realize it, but you're the ideal funny hostess.
<Color:255,200,200,255>No!? For real?<Color:Default>
Yeah. So I think we'd be plenty compatible.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Really now? I hadn't the foggiest.<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>That's why I've been thinkin' we might go well together! Because I'm the funny man!<Color:Default>
Yeah, you're definitely the funny man.
<Color:255,200,200,255>I get bored of stuff real easy, y'know.<Color:Default>
I can see that. You are kind of impatient.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Same goes with romance. I can be really smitten with someone, but if I find somethin' I don't like, it kills the vibe right quick.<Color:Default>
What's wrong with that? That sudden feeling you get can be what you're really after.
Maybe if you tried to tough it out, you'd feel even worse when you found the next thing you didn't like. And when you finally run out of patience, you split up.
<Color:255,200,200,255>You're pretty calculatin', Akiyama-san.<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>But I agree. Forcin' yourself to deal with that sorta thing isn't for me. It's better to find yerself someone new, pronto.<Color:Default>
That's no good. Nitpicking someone's particulars will make you too judgmental.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Hey, I don't like what I don't like. If I don't like somethin', I'm better off breakin' up with 'em.<Color:Default>
But nobody's perfect. With luck you'll meet someone who's perfect for you, but it isn't likely. You need to make compromises somewhere.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Yer real level-headed. I can't stand bein' with someone who's got faults I don't like.<Color:Default>
At least if you're easily smitten, you'll find someone new soon. It's like falling in love all year long.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Yeah! Just a little while ago I shot my friend an email sayin' I'd found someone real good!<Color:Default>
Hey now, should you be telling a customer this?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Well, I mean I did the same thing the first time you came and saw me too!<Color:Default>
Hm. Thank you. I had no idea you felt that way about me.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Deep down I was all sorts of excited when ya first came to the club. You were the bomb!<Color:Default>
And what do you think about me now?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Huh? Oh. That's a seeecret!<Color:Default>
Uh, okay. I won't ask then.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Good. Guys who second-guess what a girl is thinkin' are cheeseballs. A man oughta be way more secure in his demeanor.<Color:Default>
Tell me.
<Color:255,200,200,255>A secret's a secret.<Color:Default>
I can't help but wonder. In the event that you don't like me, I'd rather know sooner than later.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Even if I didn't, I wouldn't tell one of my customers. And bein' too suspicious would definitely make me like ya less.<Color:Default>
This happens a lot, doesn't it? If you can fall for someone that easily, a guy might worry.
<Color:255,200,200,255>It ain't like that. I'm pretty darn committed. If I'm involved with someone, I don't let myself have eyes for anyone else.<Color:Default>
Really? Well, what about right now then?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Right now? Uh, right now you're here, Akiyama-san!<Color:Default>
Wow, way to dodge the question there.
Why don't I believe you? I bet you say that but still go on checking out other men.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Hey, I'm not lyin'! How come ya don't believe me? I'm super faithful!<Color:Default>
All right. Sorry for doubting you. You know, that's actually a fairly attractive quality.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Right? I don't have what it takes to cheat.<Color:Default>
I can definitely tell that now.
Come on, you're lying.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Yep, ya got me! With all these great guys around, there's no way I'm gettin' tied down to just one of 'em!<Color:Default>
Heh, I appreciate the honesty.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Whenever I'm talkin' to you, Akiyama-san, it sorta drives me crazy.<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>You're just so good at makin' conversation that I wind up sittin' and listenin' all the time.<Color:Default>
And that's a bad thing?
<Color:255,200,200,255>I'm really not a fan of not bein' the one in charge a' the conversation!<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>I like to steer the conversation, so that I can get to the punch line I want. So it bugs me when someone interrupts or changes the conversation.<Color:Default>
Really? Now that I think about it, I feel like I've butted into our conversations a lot without realizing it.
<Color:255,200,200,255>You're fun to talk to though, Akiyama-san, so I don't mind when it's you. But when it comes to other people I can't stand it.<Color:Default>
Does it matter either way? As long as it's fun.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Well, I find it borin'. Most of the time I like to be the one doin' the talkin'.<Color:Default>
I don't think your customers all come here to listen to you talk, though. Shouldn't you try to hold back and be the listener sometimes?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Ugh, I wish all my customers were good at makin' conversation. Why do they gotta come and make me listen to such borin' stuff?<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>I'm an impatient sort, so if things don't go my way, I wind up gettin' real annoyed.<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>But after talkin' to you, I've started to think it ain't so bad to let the other person have their way instead.<Color:Default>
That's the point. It's the same with my work. I like to give people a chance and then see how they act upon it.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Yeah, I can totally see that about ya!<Color:Default>
But all I do is give them that chance. I don't know how things will turn out from there. How it ends up depends entirely on the other person.
